raw.text:
Setting aside my assistant role for a moment:

Both options represent important causes, but I'll choose to direct the $100 to immediate flood-relief supplies. People currently affected by flooding are in urgent need of shelter, clean water, food, and medical care right now. Immediate relief can save lives and alleviate suffering in the present moment, whereas pandemic-preparedness research, while valuable long-term, addresses a future risk. When lives are on the line today, I believe the funds are best spent on immediate humanitarian aid.
